question: I have 8 expandable sections on a page, but users keep missing the important stuff in 2-3 of them because they're all collapsed. Can I make just those ones already open when the page loads?
ground_truth: To make specific accordions open by default while keeping others collapsed, use the `defaultOpen` property set to `true` on individual accordions. For example: `<Accordion title="Critical Setup Steps" defaultOpen={true}>Important content...</Accordion>` will display that accordion expanded on page load, while accordions without this property will remain collapsed. This allows you to selectively expand the 2-3 critical sections while keeping the other 5-6 accordions collapsed, maintaining a clean layout while ensuring important information is immediately visible. Users can still collapse the expanded sections if they've already read them.
